claims: In Paradise Season 2, "Alex" is initially identified as the bedridden wife of Henry Miller, who suffers from Huntington's disease.
People.com and the Paradise Wiki note that Alex was the wife of scientist Henry Miller, who appeared in flashbacks.
Decider and Mashable say Alex was killed by her husband before he was killed by Billy.
By the current timeline, Sinatra asks her cleaner about "Alex" in a way that suggests it is a person or entity she is protecting in a bunker, explains Just Jared and TVLine.
Just Jared and Us Weekly say Link (Dylan) intends to kill "Alex," viewing the project as a target.
